min_supported_doc: The OLDEST Passwall-Node version this panel still tests. Everything from this row onward in released_nodes is the supported set, and that set is exactly what the released-range CI matrix exercises. MATCHED BY POSITION IN released_nodes, NOT by a version comparison. The positional rule was introduced because the legacy scheme's dotless prereleases sorted wrongly as text ('v0.0.1-beta9' above 'v0.0.1-beta11'), so comparing the strings would have silently inverted the floor. THAT REASON IS GONE - a version is three integers now, and integers compare correctly - and the mechanism stays because it is the one both sides already implement: the planner slices this list by indexOf exactly as this field is read. THIS SELECTS WHAT IS TESTED, NOT WHAT MAY CONNECT. No production code reads this field.
